receipts.title: Scan a receipt
receipts.intro: Take a clear photo of your till slip. We'll check what you paid against the normal price.
receipts.consent: I agree that {brand} reads my slip to confirm my savings and to improve prices for my shops. Card numbers and names are removed, and the photo is deleted after 30 days.
receipts.confirmed: Confirmed: you paid {paid}. Normal price {normal}. Saved {saved}.
receipts.unmatchedNote: Lines we couldn't match are shown but don't count towards your savings.
receipts.needsReview: The total on your slip didn't add up, so we couldn't confirm it. Try a clearer photo of the whole slip.
receipts.failed: We couldn't read that slip. Try again with a flat, well-lit photo.
receipts.tooLarge: That photo is too big even after shrinking it. Try again.
receipts.cap: You can scan 5 slips a day. Try again tomorrow.

tweak.label: Change something?
tweak.placeholder: e.g. No fish this week, quicker meals
tweak.notUnderstood: Sorry, we didn't understand that. Try 'no fish' or 'quicker meals'.
tweak.cap: You can make 10 changes a day.
tweak.failed: We couldn't change the plan right now.

admin.leafletHelp: Upload leaflets the retailer publishes for customers (PDF or photos, up to 4 MB). Claude reads them; nothing is published until you approve each batch.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: {brand} plans suppers around your budget. Here is what we keep and why, in plain language.
privacy.location: Location: we only keep your area to about 100 metres, to find shops near you. We never track where you go.
privacy.household: Your plan: the number of people, your budget and the foods you avoid, so we can plan suppers.
privacy.receipts: Receipts: only if you choose to scan one. We read the products and prices, remove card numbers, names and phone numbers, and delete the photo after 30 days.
privacy.push: Reminders: only if you allow them. You can switch each kind off in Settings.
privacy.noAds: No adverts, no ad trackers, and we never sell your data.
privacy.rights: You can download or delete your data any time in Settings → Data & privacy.
privacy.contact: Questions about your data: contact us using the email in the app store listing.

coach.actionsText: Swap a supper, pick a cheaper one, or remove it. The total updates straight away.
coach.listText: Your list is grouped by shop and aisle, and works without data.
